name: blastradius
description: Single-plugin marketplace publishing blastradius: process sized to what a change can reach rather than to its diff.

plugins.name: blastradius
plugins.description: Reach, not size. A classifier that makes a change heavy on contact with CI, releases, goldens, public surfaces, required checks, policy, dependencies, user-visible output or concurrency, and makes light a claim the agent must enumerate and state. Composes with lastmile (whether you finish) and ponytail (how much you build).
